name: Star Trek: Operation Enterprise
description: The world's first and only Star Trek licensed roller coaster — a spectacular Mack Rides multi-launch coaster that opened in 2017 as Movie Park Germany's most ambitious attraction ever built. Set in a completely new Star Trek themed area, Operation Enterprise catapults riders into warp speed with a powerful launch sequence before tearing through inversions, airtime hills and the signature Star Trek aesthetic. The 40-metre-tall coaster is the second tallest structure in the park and features IMAscore atmospheric music and authentic Star Trek theming throughout. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Van Helsing's Factory
description: Movie Park Germany's most popular dark ride coaster — a spectacular indoor Gerstlauer Bobsled roller coaster themed to the vampire hunter Van Helsing and his shadowy factory. Guests board cars that wind through an atmospheric steampunk factory environment filled with vampires, special effects, lighting and an intense IMAscore soundtrack before the coaster section delivers genuine speed and surprises in near-complete darkness. Van Helsing's Factory combines the best elements of a dark ride and a roller coaster to create an experience that thrills both families and coaster enthusiasts. Min. height: 120cm.

name: The High Fall
description: Movie Park Germany's most dramatic thrill ride — an Intamin Tilting Gyro Drop tower that lifts riders slowly to a breathtaking 60 metres above the park before tilting outward over the edge and releasing them in a sudden freefall plunge at 90 km/h. The deliberate slow ascent builds excruciating anticipation and the tilting mechanism adds a unique disorienting element to the standard drop tower experience. The views from 60 metres over the Ruhr region are spectacular before the terror begins. Min. height: 145cm.

name: Bandit
description: Germany's first modern wooden roller coaster since the 1980s — Bandit opened in 1999 as Wild Wild West and was a landmark moment for German theme parks. Based on the design of the legendary Coney Island Cyclone, Bandit delivers the classic combination of thundering wooden structure, lateral forces and airtime that only a great wooden coaster can provide. Though currently closed for maintenance, Bandit has been a beloved Ruhr area institution for over 25 years and remains one of the most historically significant wooden coasters in Germany. Check the park website for reopening dates. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Movie Park Studio Tour
description: A unique indoor roller coaster experience housed in the building that once contained the legendary Ice Age Adventure — Movie Park Studio Tour takes riders on a cinematic journey through spectacular movie-themed sets and scenes in a coaster that combines story, atmosphere and genuine thrills. Opened in 2021 to celebrate the park's 25th anniversary, Studio Tour is one of the most creatively ambitious attractions Movie Park Germany has ever built. Min. height: 120cm.

name: NYC Transformer
description: A spectacular swinging ship that goes over the top — a full 360-degree inverting experience that subjects riders to intense positive and negative g-forces as it completes full rotations against the backdrop of a New York City themed setting. The NYC Transformer is one of the most extreme flat rides at Movie Park Germany and delivers sustained thrills that rival any roller coaster in the park. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Side Kick
description: A Huss Frisbee ride that spins riders around continuously on a large rotating disc while also swinging them to significant heights — combining the spinning sensation of a flat ride with the swinging forces of a pendulum for a genuinely disorienting and exciting experience. Side Kick is one of the most popular thrill rides at Movie Park Germany among riders who want intense flat ride sensations. Min. height: 145cm.

name: Mystery River
description: One of Movie Park Germany's oldest and most beloved attractions — a classic river rapids ride recently given a complete thematic redesign with new waiting area, theming, effects and an atmospheric IMAscore soundtrack. Mystery River sends circular rafts through churning white water channels and past dramatic scenery guaranteeing thoroughly soaked riders and non-stop laughter throughout. The redesign has elevated this classic attraction into one of the most atmospheric water rides in the Ruhr region. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Area 51 - Top Secret
description: A thrilling Intamin spillwater ride themed to the mysterious Area 51 — a water ride where boats navigate through alien-themed scenes and atmospheric effects before a dramatic splashing finale. Area 51 was completely rethemed in 2019 with a new name, new IMAscore soundtrack and updated theming that transformed what was once the Bermuda Triangle attraction into one of the most distinctive water rides at any German theme park. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Ghost Chasers
description: A fun ghost-themed dark ride where riders board cars that navigate through a haunted house environment filled with sharp turns, surprising scares and atmospheric ghostly effects. Ghost Chasers is a classic fairground-style dark ride that has delighted younger visitors and families at Movie Park Germany for years — accessible for most ages and a reliable crowd-pleaser throughout the day. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Avatar Air Glider
description: A suspended family coaster inspired by the Avatar franchise that carries riders in hanging trains through sweeping turns and dips at accessible speeds — delivering the sensation of gliding through the air in an attraction perfectly suited to families with children looking for their first taste of coaster excitement. The Avatar theming creates an immersive jungle flying experience. Min. height: 95cm with adult.

name: Crazy Surfer
description: A popular wave-simulating surf ride at the Santa Monica Pier themed area where riders stand on surfboard-shaped platforms and try to maintain balance as the ride simulates the motion of ocean waves. Crazy Surfer is one of the most fun and interactive attractions at Movie Park Germany and consistently draws enthusiastic crowds — the competitive element of trying to stay on longer than other riders adds to the appeal. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Nick Racers
description: A fun Nickelodeon-themed racing coaster in the colourful Nickland area — a family-friendly attraction featuring beloved characters from the Nickelodeon universe where two trains race side by side through a compact but exciting layout. Nick Racers is one of the most popular family coasters in Nickland and provides the perfect introduction to racing coasters for younger visitors. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Backyardigans: Mission to Mars
description: An exciting and colourful family-friendly space adventure ride themed to the beloved Backyardigans cartoon series — a spinning coaster that takes younger riders on a mission to Mars through fun and accessible thrills that introduce children to the excitement of roller coasters in a completely safe and welcoming environment. Perfect for families with young children aged 4 and above. Min. height: 90cm with adult.
